title: GitHub Actions: build + push container image to ghcr.io
description: GitHub Actions workflow: on tag push (v*), build Docker image, push to ghcr.io/markatwood/baize:latest and ghcr.io/markatwood/baize:{tag}. Multi-arch: linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 (for M-series Macs). Uses docker/build-push-action. GITHUB_TOKEN for auth. Also builds on PR for validation (no push). README badge for latest image.
